newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets $24 mln Kuwait cellular deal.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets $24 mln Kuwait cellular deal.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Cellular Infrastructure Group said Monday it signed a $24 million contract to expand the global system for Mobile Communications (GSM) wireless phone network in Kuwait.
The project, with the Mobile Telecommunications Co, will allow the network to handle 155,000 subscribers.
Motorola said the deal is its third GSM expansion contract in Kuwait in three years. The original system was installed by Motorola in November 1994 to serve 50,000 subscribers.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems, components and services.
